Model all-different as a bipartite graph: variables on one side, domain values on the other. A maximum matching smaller than the number of variables proves infeasibility of the current domains. A covering matching satisfies only all-different; additional pairwise constraints can still make the problem infeasible. Prune an edge only if no variable-covering matching contains it—not merely because one chosen matching omits it. Régin’s algorithm implements this efficiently; a simpler correctness reference forces each candidate assignment and checks whether the remaining variables admit a covering matching. [Régin, 1994](https://cse.unl.edu/~choueiry/Documents/ReginAAAI-1994.pdf)

For minimization, initialize branch-and-bound with an independently validated feasible incumbent of cost U. Prune a node only when its valid lower bound is at least U, if seeking strictly better solutions; reverse inequalities for maximization. Preserve the incumbent when search stops. Exhausting an improvement search proves the incumbent optimal, not the original problem infeasible. SCIP explicitly distinguishes a bound backed by a feasible solution from a user-supplied objective cutoff. [SCIP documentation](https://www.scipopt.org/doc-6.0.1/html/primal_8h.php)

Recommended independent check: exhaustively enumerate tiny instances using a separate direct constraint checker; compare feasible sets and optimum values, and verify that propagation preserves every feasible assignment. Include surplus values, Hall violations, incompatible pairwise constraints, and interrupted searches. Constraint-testing research supports checking propagator correctness independently. Report time/node limits as incomplete search: OR-Tools distinguishes UNKNOWN, FEASIBLE, and proven INFEASIBLE. A Hall-deficient variable subset provides a checkable matching infeasibility witness; otherwise require a completed sound search or independently checkable proof. [Testing Global Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.03975), [OR-Tools status guidance](https://github.com/google/or-tools/blob/stable/ortools/sat/docs/troubleshooting.md)
